name: Eshban
title: Descendant of Seir the Horite
summary: Eshban was a son of Dishon and a grandson of Seir the Horite. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the Horite clan leaders who lived in the land of Seir (Edom) before the Edomites took over the area.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Seir's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Eshban is listed as a son of Dishon in the list of Seir's descendants, the Horites who lived in the land of Edom.

keyEvents.title: Horite Chiefs in Seir
keyEvents.description: Eshban belonged to the Horite clans that were the original inhabitants of the land of Seir before Esau's descendants drove them out.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Esban's lineage is repeated in 1 Chronicles as part of the historical overview of the nations.

keyEvents.title: The People of the Land of Seir
keyEvents.description: The Horites, including Esban's clan, were those who originally inhabited the mountainous region of Seir before the Edomites took over.
